title: Dan Dan Noodles
subtitle: Sichuan noodles with sesame, chilli oil, and pork mince
excerpt: Dan dan noodles (dandan mian) are a Sichuan street food of wheat noodles in a sauce of sesame paste, chilli oil, Sichuan pepper, and dark soy sauce, topped with seasoned pork mince and spring onion. The name comes from the shoulder poles (dan) street vendors used to carry their pots and woks.
sourceNotes: Dan dan noodles are a Chengdu street food dating to the 19th century. The original street-vendor version was sold from a portable charcoal stove balanced on a bamboo shoulder pole (dan). The sauce is now considered one of the defining flavour combinations of Sichuan cooking: numbing, spicy, savoury, with the rich undertone of sesame.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The sauce and meat topping can be made up to 2 days ahead. Cook the noodles fresh.

content.text: Dan dan noodles are assembled bowl by bowl: sauce in the bottom, hot noodles on top, meat topping, garnish. The sauce is not cooked; it is stirred together from pantry ingredients and is done in 5 minutes. The complexity comes from layering: sesame, chilli, numbing Sichuan pepper, and the savoury depth of dark soy.

items.prepNote: 2 tbsp for the meat topping, 3 tbsp for the sauce

content.text: Make the sauce: whisk together the tahini, peanut butter, chilli oil, sesame oil, Sichuan pepper, rice vinegar, garlic, caster sugar, and 3 tablespoons of dark soy sauce. Loosen with 4 to 6 tablespoons of hot water until the sauce coats a spoon but is pourable. Taste. Adjust with more chilli oil, soy, or vinegar.

Cook the meat topping: heat the sunflower oil in a frying pan. Add the pork mince and cook over high heat, breaking it up, until browned and crisp in places. Add 2 tablespoons of dark soy sauce and the sake. Toss and cook for 1 more minute. Remove from the heat.
Cook the noodles according to the packet. Drain and rinse briefly in cold water to prevent sticking.
Divide the sauce between 4 bowls. Top with noodles, then the pork. Scatter with spring onion. Serve immediately. Diners mix everything together at the table.

items.symptom: Sauce is too thick and pasty
items.cause: Not enough hot water added to loosen the tahini
items.fix: Add hot water a tablespoon at a time and whisk. The sesame paste absorbs a lot of water before it loosens.
